volumes.L: bare forearm, hand and fingers (645 vertices)

idle.purpose: relaxed breathing stance, weight drifting between the feet
idle.maps_to: alive, not moving, out of combat (no enemy near, no attack for 2 s; hub)

idle_combat.purpose: combat-ready stance: guard up, a light bounce on the knees
idle_combat.maps_to: alive, not moving, in combat (enemies near or an attack in the last 2 s). Frame 0 is the reference pose of every upper-layer clip

walk.purpose: heavy walk, gauntlets swinging at the sides
walk.maps_to: moving at under about 55 % of move speed (stick partly pushed, slows); playback rate = speed / 1.84 m/s

run.purpose: brawler run: forward lean, gauntlets pumping in front of the ribs
run.maps_to: moving within 45 deg of the aim at move speed; playback rate = speed / 7.2 m/s

strafe_left.purpose: side run to the hero's left, hips opened toward the travel, chest and gun kept on the aim
strafe_left.maps_to: moving 45-135 deg to the left of the aim; playback rate = speed / 7.2 m/s

strafe_right.purpose: side run to the hero's right (the mirror of strafe_left)
strafe_right.maps_to: moving 45-135 deg to the right of the aim; playback rate = speed / 7.2 m/s

backpedal.purpose: backpedal on the balls of the feet, the gun on the aim, weight forward
backpedal.maps_to: moving more than 135 deg away from the aim; playback rate = speed / 7.2 m/s

dash.purpose: the dash burst: a low shoulder-led lunge-glide, the lead gauntlet driving forward, the rear one trailing
dash.maps_to: the 0.16 s dash (MoverState.dash_left > 0); the client faces the hero along the dash for its duration

dash_recover.purpose: landing out of the dash: the lead foot plants, a heavy absorb, back to the guard
dash_recover.maps_to: the first 0.45 s after a dash ends when the hero is not moving on (else blend into locomotion)

fire_light.purpose: a snap shot: the gun arm locks out down the aim line, the muzzle kicks up and settles
fire_light.maps_to: each primary shot of a light chassis (fire_rate >= 2/s); Kael's serpent_smg plays kael_fire_r

fire_heavy.purpose: a braced heavy shot: the ghost hand cups the gun hand, a load, the shot, a big muzzle kick into the chest
fire_heavy.maps_to: a heavy / charged release (fire_rate < 1/s, charge release, splash chassis)

fire_charge.purpose: holding a charge: both hands on the gun, braced, the aim trembling
fire_charge.maps_to: fire held on a Charge chassis (FireKind::Charge) until release (then fire_heavy)

hit_light.purpose: a flinch: head snaps, the guard is knocked back, absorb, recover
hit_light.maps_to: PlayerFlags::HIT on a light hit (damage < 10 % max HP), layered over whatever plays

hit_heavy.purpose: a big stagger: blown back, the lead foot steps back, absorb low, step back in
hit_heavy.maps_to: PlayerFlags::HIT on a heavy hit (damage >= 10 % max HP or a stun); interrupts upper-layer clips

knockdown.purpose: blown off the feet: impact, a backward fall, the bounce, lying on the back
knockdown.maps_to: a knockback / launch strong enough to floor the hero (stun >= 0.8 s); holds its last frame until get_up

get_up.purpose: from the back: sit up on the hands, roll onto one knee, push up into the guard

death.purpose: the fatal blow: head snaps back, knees buckle to the ground, topples face down, the gun arm flung out
death.maps_to: LifeState::Downed begins (GameEvent::Downed); holds its last frame, then downed@loop (wraith look)

downed.purpose: the wraith drift: slumped, floating 0.35 m off the ground, limbs trailing, a slow bob
downed.maps_to: LifeState::Downed (the Soul-Tether wraith; moves at 45 % speed with no gait, the client adds the ghost material)

revive.purpose: pulled back into the body: a jolt, the feet slam down, crouch, rise into the guard
revive.maps_to: an ally completes the Soul-Tether revive (Downed -> Alive)

reforge_in.purpose: forged anew: rises from a one-knee landing (the ghost fist planted), flips the gun up past his face, aims
reforge_in.maps_to: LifeState::Reforging ends: the hero reappears next to an ally

victory.purpose: the roar: a crouch, then one gauntlet thrust to the sky, chest out; holds the pose
victory.maps_to: the run is won (GameEvent victory / boss down, results screen); holds its last frame

ping.purpose: a ping: the ghost hand points along the aim, open, the head follows; the gun stays on the aim

interact.purpose: work the anvil: lean over and press the open ghost hand flat onto it, the gun held low, then straighten
interact.maps_to: the interact input at an anvil / forge / shrine POI (PoiState use); 1.3 s

forge_hammer.purpose: hammering the anvil with the ghost fist, the gun hand held low at his side
forge_hammer.maps_to: the forge / hub anvil upgrade (Forge screen open, hub idle at the anvil)

idle_signature.purpose: signature idle: brings the serpent_smg up past his face, spins it on his hand, lowers it, then flexes the ghost hand in front of him and watches it glow
idle_signature.maps_to: alive and idle for 6 s or more (out of combat); in the hub and the character select

fan_of_blades.purpose: Fan of Blades: the gun drops to the hip, the open ghost hand winds up high and fans across the gun's back; the spectral shotgun burst leaves the muzzle on the fan
fan_of_blades.maps_to: kits.ron kael active1 Fan of Blades (Cone 6.5 m, 70 deg, Mark) on 'burst'; upper layer, so it fires on the move

shadow_roll.purpose: Shadow Roll: a low dive into a tight forward roll (the coat wraps), lands crouched with the gun already coming up, rises into the aim
shadow_roll.maps_to: kits.ron kael active2 Shadow Roll (Rush 5 m in 0.22 s, i-frames): the roll plays while the Rush moves (frames 2-9), then the recovery

ghost_step.purpose: Ghost Step: the refreshed dash, a low gliding lean with the gun still on the aim and the ghost arm trailing behind, then a light landing back on the aim
ghost_step.maps_to: the dash Ghost Step refreshes (passive dash_refund / a kill): plays instead of dash + dash_recover

bullet_ballet_start.purpose: Bullet Ballet: arms crossed low, then flung wide as the spectral twin forms in the ghost hand, both guns swing onto the aim
bullet_ballet_start.maps_to: kits.ron kael ultimate Bullet Ballet cast: the twin pistol (VFX on weapon_L) appears on 'twin'

bullet_ballet.purpose: Bullet Ballet stance: both arms up down the aim, on the balls of the feet, a quick bounce and a sway
bullet_ballet.maps_to: replaces idle_combat while the Bullet Ballet buff lasts (6 s); kael_fire_twin layers on top

fire_twin.purpose: the Bullet Ballet twin shot: the gun hand, then the spectral twin in the ghost hand, each kicks up
fire_twin.maps_to: each shot while Bullet Ballet lasts (the twin copies the Mechanism), layered over kael_bullet_ballet@loop

fire_r.purpose: the serpent_smg's rapid shot: a short lock-out and a small muzzle kick, short enough for its fire rate
fire_r.maps_to: each primary shot of the serpent_smg (rapid); the recoil shake stays procedural
